customers_say: Customers find this water purifier to be among the best in the market, offering good value for money with transparent pricing and the ability to save on service costs. They appreciate its premium appearance, excellent installation process, and performance, noting it makes a noticeable difference in water quality. The taste receives mixed feedback, with some customers finding it excellent while others disagree.

reviews.author: anand choubey
reviews.title: Amazing product.
reviews.body: It been 2 months using this RO, and it’s working flawlessly. Water taste is clean and tds below 50. Not much to complain except you can’t attach a pipe to the outlet because of its weird shape.

reviews.author: Prashant N.
reviews.title: Recommended. Great water purifier
reviews.body: Water quality si absolutely great. Good app UI and adequate information provided in the app. Value for money. Good service.

reviews.author: Viraj sharma
reviews.title: Excellent Product with Professional Installation
reviews.body: I’m extremely satisfied with this purchase. The product arrived in excellent condition and feels premium in terms of build quality. It offers plenty of useful features, and the water flow is impressive. The installation experience was equally outstanding. The installation technician was highly professional, completed the work quickly, and explained all the product features in detail. Their product knowledge and willingness to answer questions made the entire experience smooth and hassle-free. Overall, an excellent product backed by top-notch installation service. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: JAIDEEP DAS
reviews.title: Worth the buy
reviews.body: Great Buy. Worth the value, highly recommended, Saves water, Mobile app works fine, can check all the details. Easy installation.
